sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using QuantMesh Market Maker ("the System"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the System. The System is provided for quantitative trading research and learning purposes only.

sections.title: 2. Description of Service
sections.content: QuantMesh is a quantitative trading system that supports grid trading, DCA, and other algorithmic strategies. The System connects to supported cryptocurrency exchanges via API. You are responsible for configuring, monitoring, and managing your trading activities.

sections.title: 3. Risk Disclaimer
sections.content: Cryptocurrency trading involves significant risk and may result in loss of principal. Past performance does not guarantee future results. The System is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. You use the System at your own risk and are solely responsible for any trading decisions and outcomes.

sections.title: 4. User Responsibilities
sections.content: You are responsible for: (a) maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials; (b) ensuring your use complies with applicable laws; (c) understanding the risks of cryptocurrency and leveraged trading; (d) monitoring your positions and system status. The System assumes no liability for losses arising from misuse, configuration errors, or market conditions.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, QuantMesh and its contributors shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, or trading capital. Your use of the System is at your sole risk.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: QuantMesh Market Maker is designed to run locally or on your own infrastructure. The System primarily stores configuration data, trading logs, and analytics locally. No personal data is transmitted to third parties by default. API keys and credentials are stored in your local configuration and used only to communicate with exchanges you authorize.

sections.title: 2. Data Storage
sections.content: All data is stored on the machine where you deploy QuantMesh. This includes strategy configurations, position data, order history, and system metrics. We do not collect or store your data on external servers unless you explicitly configure such integrations (e.g., cloud backup, external monitoring).

sections.title: 3. Exchange APIs
sections.content: When you connect to cryptocurrency exchanges, the System sends necessary requests (orders, positions, market data) to those exchanges. Your API keys and trading activity are governed by each exchange's own privacy policy. We recommend using API keys with minimal required permissions.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Sessions
sections.content: The web interface uses session cookies for authentication. These are stored locally in your browser and are not shared with external parties. Session data is used solely to maintain your login state.

sections.title: 5. Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top indicates when the policy was last revised. Continued use of the System after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
